note: Pets launch layout, 49 effects across 8 rooms. Rooms are DELIBERATELY UNEVEN for this launch — Rich's call. Portraits is 7x7; Pets is not. Do not pad rooms to seven.

speciesAxis.note: The Pets analogue of the Portraits gender toggle. Inferred from analyze, NOT user-overridable — nobody wants their cat shown as a lizard. Selects which preview the card shows and which plate reaches NB2. Prompts are species-agnostic and never branch on this.

promptSource.note: Where each body comes from. 'tonight' bodies are 350-500 chars and outperformed the 2400-3000 char bench prompts on every axis. Bench prompts must be compressed on the way in, not copied.
promptSource.portraitsNeedPetRewrite: All fromPortraits bodies are written for humans — bust framing, garments, hairstyle. They need the pet substitutions: full body nose to tail, markings as the identity anchor, no garment, muzzle for mouth, collar and tags allowed.

cut.note: Removed from the 71-row union. Duplicates resolved in favour of the pet-written version.

duplicateResolved.persian_court: persian_royalty — kept the version written for pets

weak.fire_face: dog plus fire, not dog IS fire
weak.daguerreotype: reviewer liked it; Rich cut it

rules.framing: Full body, nose to tail. There is no mid-chest crop for pets.
rules.likenessAnchor: Markings. They do for a pet what facial structure does for a person.
rules.props: Collars and tags are identity, not props, and are always allowed. Costume props — the pipe, the badge, the pocket watch — are the joke and must not be suppressed.
rules.negatives: Only for artefacts the model adds unprompted, chiefly stray lettering. Never write an avoid list for the thing you want.
rules.species: Bodies say 'the cat or dog' even when the species is known. It lets NB2 choose species-appropriate garments. A macaw got a waistcoat around its wings; a skink stood up in a sheriff's vest.
rules.colour: Period colour instructions attach to the whole photograph, never to the animal. 'Fade the pet' was ignored; 'give the entire photograph the muted palette' worked.
rules.gating: Gate on the source photograph — readable face, two visible eyes, distinct silhouette. Never publish a species list.

sources.note: 25 generated source photographs, five per species, at lib/v1/pets/sources/<species>/. Every effect plate is shot against these so the same animals recur across the catalog.
